description: This file defines the JsonErrorRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering JSON formatted error responses in the Slim Framework. It inherits from AbstractErrorRenderer and implements the __invoke method to generate error JSON, optionally including detailed exception information.

classes.name: JsonErrorRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders error information as JSON in the Slim Framework. It extends AbstractErrorRenderer and provides detailed error formatting including exception chain.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the rendering of the error as a JSON string, optionally including detailed exception information based on the displayErrorDetails flag.

methods.name: formatExceptionFragment
methods.description: Formats an individual Throwable exception into an array with type, code, message, file, and line information.
